wisdom.title: Morning Wisdom
wisdom.text:
🌅 0600 Morning Wisdom
The Lord calls His people to purge the corruption that creeps into the sanctuary of His house, demanding total fidelity from those who serve Him.
📖 Scripture — Nehemiah 13
On that day they read from the Book of Moses in the hearing of the people, and in it was found written that no Ammonite or Moabite should ever come into the assembly of God,
because they had not met the children of Israel with bread and water, but hired Balaam against them to curse them. However, our God turned the curse into a blessing.
So it was, when they had heard the Law, that they separated all the mixed multitude from Israel.
Now before this, Eliashib the priest, having authority over the storerooms of the house of our God, was allied with Tobiah.
And he had prepared for him a large room, where previously they had stored the grain offerings, the frankincense, the articles, the tithes of grain, the new wine and oil, which were commanded to be given to the Levites and singers and gatekeepers, and the offerings for the priests.
But during all this I was not in Jerusalem, for in the thirty-second year of Artaxerxes king of Babylon I had returned to the king. Then after certain days I obtained leave from the king,
and I came to Jerusalem and discovered the evil that Eliashib had done for Tobiah, in preparing a room for him in the courts of the house of God.
And it grieved me bitterly; therefore I threw all the household goods of Tobiah out of the room.
Then I commanded them to cleanse the rooms; and I brought back into them the articles of the house of God, with the grain offering and the frankincense.
I also realized that the portions for the Levites had not been given them; for each of the Levites and the singers who did the work had gone back to his field.
So I contended with the rulers, and said, “Why is the house of God forsaken?” And I gathered them together and set them in their place.
Then all Judah brought the tithe of the grain and the new wine and the oil to the storehouse.
And I appointed as treasurers over the storehouse Shelemiah the priest and Zadok the scribe, and of the Levites, Pedaiah; and next to them was Hanan the son of Zaccur, the son of Mattaniah; for they were considered faithful, and their task was to distribute to their brethren.
Remember me, O my God, concerning this, and do not wipe out my good deeds that I have done for the house of my God, and for its services!
In those days I saw people in Judah treading wine presses on the Sabbath, and bringing in sheaves, and loading donkeys with wine, grapes, figs, and all kinds of burdens, which they brought into Jerusalem on the Sabbath day. And I warned them about the day on which they were selling provisions.
Men of Tyre dwelt there also, who brought in fish and all kinds of goods, and sold them on the Sabbath to the children of Judah, and in Jerusalem.
Then I contended with the nobles of Judah, and said to them, “What evil thing is this that you do, by which you profane the Sabbath day?
Did not your fathers do thus, and did not our God bring all this disaster on us and on this city? Yet you bring added wrath on Israel by profaning the Sabbath.”
So it was, at the gates of Jerusalem, as it began to be dark before the Sabbath, that I commanded the gates to be shut, and charged that they must not be opened till after the Sabbath. Then I posted some of my servants at the gates, so that no burdens would be brought in on the Sabbath day.
Now the merchants and sellers of all kinds of wares lodged outside Jerusalem once or twice.
Then I warned them, and said to them, “Why do you spend the night around the wall? If you do so again, I will lay hands on you!” From that time on they came no more on the Sabbath.
And I commanded the Levites that they should cleanse themselves, and that they should go and guard the gates, to sanctify the Sabbath day. Remember me, O my God, concerning this also, and spare me according to the greatness of Your mercy!
In those days I also saw Jews who had married women of Ashdod, Ammon, and Moab.
And half of their children spoke the language of Ashdod, and could not speak the language of Judah, but spoke according to the language of one or the other people.
So I contended with them and cursed them, struck some of them and pulled out their hair, and made them swear by God, saying, “You shall not give your daughters as wives to their sons, nor take their daughters for your sons or yourselves.
Did not Solomon king of Israel sin by these things? Yet among many nations there was no king like him, who was beloved of his God; and God made him king over all Israel. Nevertheless pagan women caused even him to sin.
Should we then hear of your doing all this great evil, transgressing against our God by marrying pagan women?”
And one of the sons of Joiada, the son of Eliashib the high priest, was a son-in-law of Sanballat the Horonite; therefore I drove him from me.
Remember them, O my God, because they have defiled the priesthood and the covenant of the priesthood and the Levites.
Thus I cleansed them of everything pagan. I also assigned duties to the priests and the Levites, each to his service,
and to bringing the wood offering and the firstfruits at appointed times. Remember me, O my God, for good!
⸻
🧭 Context Summary
Nehemiah returns to Jerusalem after a period of absence to find the spiritual and physical foundations of the covenant community eroding. The temple chambers, once holy stores for the Levites, have been hijacked for personal gain, and the people have neglected their tithes, forcing the servants of God back to their fields. Furthermore, the holy line of separation between God’s people and the nations has been blurred through intermarriage, inviting the curses of Balaam into the assembly. This passage reveals the fragility of obedience and the necessity of vigilant leadership to maintain the purity of worship and the integrity of the covenant.
⸻
🛡️ Reflection for a REAL MAN — Purges Corruption
Brother, you know that a fort is only as strong as its gates, and a home is only as holy as its standards. When Nehemiah saw the temple defiled by the self-interest of Eliashib and the infiltration of foreign alliances, he did not negotiate; he acted. He threw Tobiah’s household goods into the street and commanded the cleansing of the chambers. This is the posture of a godly man: he does not tolerate the slow rot of compromise in his own life, his family, or his church. He understands that holiness requires the painful work of removal. You must be the Nehemiah in your household, clearing out the spiritual clutter that distracts your wife and children from the worship of the true God.

The negligence of the people in tithing and the Levites’ departure from their duties shows what happens when leadership fails to enforce God’s Word. The breach in the wall allowed the enemy in; the breach in the tithe starved the ministry. As a father and a man of God, you are responsible for ensuring that your house honors the Lord first. You must provide not just physically, but spiritually, by ensuring that the means for worship are maintained and that your family is not mixed with the values of a hostile world. Do not let the comfort of the age seduce you into neglecting the strict boundaries God has set.

True manhood is found in the courage to confront sin, even when it involves those in authority or those you once respected. Nehemiah confronted the nobles and restored the order of God’s house. He did not seek popularity; he sought the blessing of God. You must similarly guard the theology and practice of your home against the subtle encroachments of the world. When you see the lines of distinction blurring, you must draw them firmly again, not out of anger, but out of a fierce love for the glory of God and the protection of your covenant family.
⸻
⛏️ Personal Application — Purges Corruption
• Conduct a spiritual audit of your home this week, identifying any habits or influences that contradict the clear teaching of Scripture.
• Confront your wife and children with the importance of tithing and giving, modeling sacrificial generosity to the church.
• Establish clear boundaries for your children regarding media and friendships that do not honor the LORD.
⸻
🙏 Prayer
Father, I confess that I often tolerate sin in my own heart and home, just as Eliashib tolerated the intrusion of Tobiah. Forgive my negligence. By the power of Your Holy Spirit, give me the courage of Nehemiah to purge the corruption from my life and my household. Help me to uphold the boundaries You have set, to provide for Your people, and to lead my family in the fear of the LORD. Let my house be a sanctuary of truth and holiness. In the name of Jesus Christ. Amen.
⸻
🛡️ Watch Charge: Cast out the foreigner who seeks to occupy your inner court and defile your holy ground.

first.title: First Watch — The Husband's Post
first.text:
🕖 0700 First Watch — The Husband's Post

Brother, the dawn light reveals the stark reality of our fallen world, yet it also illuminates the unshakeable rock upon which we stand.

📖 Scripture — Micah 7

Woe is me! For I am like those who gather summer fruits, Like those who glean vintage grapes; There is no cluster to eat Of the first-ripe fruit which my soul desires.
The faithful man has perished from the earth, And there is no one upright among men. They all lie in wait for blood; Every man hunts his brother with a net.
That they may successfully do evil with both hands— The prince asks for gifts, The judge seeks a bribe, And the great man utters his evil desire; So they scheme together.
The best of them is like a brier; The most upright is sharper than a thorn hedge; The day of your watchman and your punishment comes; Now shall be their perplexity.
Do not trust in a friend; Do not put your confidence in a companion; Guard the doors of your mouth From her who lies in your bosom.
For son dishonors father, Daughter rises against her mother, Daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law; A man’s enemies are the men of his own household.
Therefore I will look to the LORD; I will wait for the God of my salvation; My God will hear me.
Do not rejoice over me, my enemy; When I fall, I will arise; When I sit in darkness, The LORD will be a light to me.
I will bear the indignation of the LORD, Because I have sinned against Him, Until He pleads my case And executes justice for me. He will bring me forth to the light; I will see His righteousness.
Then she who is my enemy will see, And shame will cover her who said to me, “Where is the LORD your God?” My eyes will see her; Now she will be trampled down Like mud in the streets.
In the day when your walls are to be built, In that day the decree shall go far and wide.
In that day they shall come to you From Assyria and the fortified cities, From the fortress to the River, From sea to sea, And mountain to mountain.
Yet the land shall be desolate Because of those who dwell in it, And for the fruit of their deeds.
Shepherd Your people with Your staff, The flock of Your heritage, Who dwell solitarily in a woodland, In the midst of Carmel; Let them feed in Bashan and Gilead, As in days of old.
“As in the days when you came out of the land of Egypt, I will show them wonders.”
The nations shall see and be ashamed of all their might; They shall put their hand over their mouth; Their ears shall be deaf.
They shall lick the dust like a serpent; They shall crawl from their holes like snakes of the earth. They shall be afraid of the LORD our God, And shall fear because of You.
Who is a God like You, Pardoning iniquity And passing over the transgression of the remnant of His heritage? He does not retain His anger forever, Because He delights in mercy.
He will again have compassion on us, And will subdue our iniquities. You will cast all our sins Into the depths of the sea.
You will give truth to Jacob And mercy to Abraham, Which You have sworn to our fathers From days of old.

⸻

🗺️ Briefing Summary

This chapter serves as a grim battlefield report of a society where trust has evaporated and familial bonds are severed by sin. The prophet laments the total collapse of moral order, yet pivots sharply to a solitary, defiant hope in the LORD. The passage contrasts the treachery of men with the faithful, punishing, and redeeming character of God. It reminds us that while the world may turn against us, our security rests solely in the covenant loyalty of the Almighty.

⸻

❤️ Reflection for Your Wife — H.A.P.P.Y. Husband — Protecting

Brother, look closely at the text. The world is not a safe place for the righteous. Micah describes a reality where even the "godly man has perished" and neighbors hunt one another like prey. This is the spiritual terrain we inhabit. As the head of your household, Adam, you are called to be a sentinel. You do not merely watch for intruders at the perimeter; you watch for the erosion of truth and the subtle incursions of sin within your own walls. Your primary duty is to protect Maria and your children from this encroaching darkness by establishing a boundary of faith and discipline.

The prophet declares, "Do not trust a brother... guard the doors of your mouth." This is a command to discernment. In a culture that celebrates openness at the cost of holiness, you must guard the spiritual atmosphere of your home. You protect by filtering the world’s noise through the sieve of Scripture before it reaches your wife’s ears. You do not coddle Maria in error; you shield her by pointing her toward the only solid ground. Your protection is not a cage, but a fortress built on the rock of Christ, where she finds rest because you have shouldered the burden of vigilance.

Yet, this protection is not self-reliant. Micah says, "I will look to the LORD... my God will hear me." You cannot protect what you do not surrender. Your strength as a husband flows from your submission to the Captain. When you stand firm in your complementarian role, not as a tyrant but with leadership that serves, you manifest the LORD’s own shepherding care. You show Maria that the God who punishes sin and pardons iniquity is the same God who empowers you to lead with grace. Your steadfastness is the visible sign of His faithfulness to your family.

⸏️ Personal Application — Protecting

• Audit the spiritual defenses of your home by reviewing media and influences that threaten the peace of your household, removing anything that dulls the discernment of your faith.
• Establish a daily time of intercession for Maria, specifically praying for her spiritual safety and the covering of the blood over her mind and heart.
• Speak truth boldly and clearly to your family, refusing to compromise biblical standards for the sake of temporary comfort or cultural approval.
🙏 Prayer from the Husband’s Post

Father, I come before You as a soldier in Your army, acknowledging the treachery of the world and the weakness of my own heart. Forgive me for the times I have failed to guard the doors of my mouth or to stand firm in the faith. I ask for the grace to be a faithful protector of my wife, Maria, and my family. By the power of Your Holy Spirit, give me the discernment to see the snares of the enemy and the courage to confront them with the sword of the Word. Make me a refuge for them, just as You are a refuge for Your people. Let my leadership reflect the shepherding heart of Christ, who laid down His life for His sheep. Through Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.

🛡️ Watch Charge: Glean the fruit of righteousness on this post before winter rots the vineyard of your soul.

second.title: Second Watch — The Father's Charge
second.text:
🕚 1100 Second Watch — The Father's Charge

Brother, the dawn brings not rest, but the solemn duty to guard the covenant household against the encroaching darkness.

📖 Scripture — Nahum 1

The burden against Nineveh. The book of the vision of Nahum the Elkoshite.
God is jealous, and the LORD avenges; The LORD avenges and is furious. The LORD will take vengeance on His adversaries, And He reserves wrath for His enemies;
The LORD is slow to anger and great in power, And will not at all acquit the wicked. The LORD has His way In the whirlwind and in the storm, And the clouds are the dust of His feet.
He rebukes the sea and makes it dry, And dries up all the rivers. Bashan and Carmel wither, And the flower of Lebanon wilts.
The mountains quake before Him, The hills melt, And the earth heaves at His presence, Yes, the world and all who dwell in it.
Who can stand before His indignation? And who can endure the fierceness of His anger? His fury is poured out like fire, And the rocks are thrown down by Him.
The LORD is good, A stronghold in the day of trouble; And He knows those who trust in Him.
But with an overflowing flood He will make an utter end of its place, And darkness will pursue His enemies.
What do you conspire against the LORD? He will make an utter end of it. Affliction will not rise up a second time.
For while tangled like thorns, And while drunken like drunkards, They shall be devoured like stubble fully dried.
From you comes forth one Who plots evil against the LORD, A wicked counselor.
Thus says the LORD: “Though they are safe, and likewise many, Yet in this manner they will be cut down When he passes through. Though I have afflicted you, I will afflict you no more;
For now I will break off his yoke from you, And burst your bonds apart.”
The LORD has given a command concerning you: “Your name shall be perpetuated no longer. Out of the house of your gods I will cut off the carved image and the molded image. I will dig your grave, For you are vile.”
Behold, on the mountains The feet of him who brings good tidings, Who proclaims peace! O Judah, keep your appointed feasts, Perform your vows. For the wicked one shall no more pass through you; He is utterly cut off.

⸻

🗺️ Field Notes

Nahum stands as a stern sentinel over Nineveh, declaring that the God who protects His people also judges the proud. The prophet reminds us that divine justice is not arbitrary, but a necessary response to entrenched evil. For the father, this passage illustrates the terrifying reality that God’s wrath is real and His power absolute. We serve a God who is both the sanctuary for the weary and the judge of the wicked.

⸻

👨‍👧 Reflection for Your Children — F.U.L.F.I.L.L.E.D. Father — Disciplining

• Gideon, at nineteen, you stand on the threshold of manhood, facing a world that often confuses strength with indulgence. You must understand that true discipline is an act of love, mirroring the Father’s own righteous anger against sin. When you enforce boundaries, you are not being harsh, but you are protecting your future from the decay of compromise. Boaz, at fourteen, you are in the thick of youth, where peer pressure often masquerades as freedom. Your father’s discipline is a shield, keeping you from the traps that ensnare the careless. Shiloh, at five, you are learning that actions have consequences, and your father’s corrections are designed to guide your heart toward obedience and the gentle, modest flourishing of a godly young woman. He disciplines you because he loves you, and because he knows the Lord disciplines those He loves.

Brother, do not shy away from the hard work of correction. The Lord is a jealous God, and He calls fathers to be jealous for the purity of their homes. When Gideon tests the limits, you must hold the line with grace and firmness. When Boaz seeks independence, you must teach him that true liberty is found under authority. When Shiloh pushes back, you must correct her with patience, knowing that the rod of discipline spares the child from the fire of judgment. Your authority is not your own; it is delegated by the King of Kings. Exercise it with wisdom, knowing that your children are watching how you relate to the Lord’s commands.

⸻

⛏️ Personal Application — Disciplining

• Establish clear, non-negotiable boundaries for Gideon regarding his digital life and moral conduct, enforcing them with immediate consequence.
• Engage Boaz in regular, direct conversations about integrity and courage, challenging him to take spiritual responsibility for his choices.
• Use consistent, age-appropriate correction for Shiloh, ensuring she understands that obedience is a reflection of her love for her Father in heaven.
🙏 Prayer from the Father’s Watch

Father, I thank You for the example of Your righteous wrath and Your holy discipline. By the power of Your Holy Spirit, give me the courage to lead my household with clarity and strength. Help me to correct Gideon with wisdom, to guide Boaz with truth, and to train Shiloh with patience. May my authority reflect Your own, not in tyranny, but in faithful stewardship. In Jesus’ name. Amen.

🛡️ Watch Charge: Let the LORD’s righteous wrath purge guilt from your house — slow to anger, great in power, no sin left unaddressed.

third.title: Third Watch — The Citizen's Stand
third.text:
🕒 1500 Third Watch — The Citizen's Stand

The day’s labor concludes with a reminder that the Lord defends His people against the arrogance of the wicked.

📖 Scripture — Nahum 2

He who scatters has come up before your face. Man the fort! Watch the road! Strengthen your flanks! Fortify your power mightily.
For the LORD will restore the excellence of Jacob Like the excellence of Israel, For the emptiers have emptied them out And ruined their vine branches.
The shields of his mighty men are made red, The valiant men are in scarlet. The chariots come with flaming torches In the day of his preparation, And the spears are brandished.
The chariots rage in the streets, They jostle one another in the broad roads; They seem like torches, They run like lightning.
He remembers his nobles; They stumble in their walk; They make haste to her walls, And the defense is prepared.
The gates of the rivers are opened, And the palace is dissolved.
It is decreed: She shall be led away captive, She shall be brought up; And her maidservants shall lead her as with the voice of doves, Beating their breasts.
Though Nineveh of old was like a pool of water, Now they flee away. “Halt! Halt!” they cry; But no one turns back.
Take spoil of silver! Take spoil of gold! There is no end of treasure, Or wealth of every desirable prize.
She is empty, desolate, and waste! The heart melts, and the knees shake; Much pain is in every side, And all their faces are drained of color.
Where is the dwelling of the lions, And the feeding place of the young lions, Where the lion walked, the lioness and lion’s cub, And no one made them afraid?
The lion tore in pieces enough for his cubs, Killed for his lionesses, Filled his caves with prey, And his dens with flesh.
“Behold, I am against you,” says the LORD of hosts, “I will burn your chariots in smoke, and the sword shall devour your young lions; I will cut off your prey from the earth, and the voice of your messengers shall be heard no more.”

⸻

🛰️ Situation Report
Nahum turns his gaze from the fall of Assyria’s capital to the certainty of its final judgment. The prophet declares that the Lord will not tolerate the plundering of His people, nor will He allow the arrogant to stand against His ordained purposes. This is a message of comfort for the faithful who suffer under tyranny and a warning of inevitable ruin for those who oppose God’s will.

⸻

🛡️ Reflection for a R.E.S.O.L.U.T.E. Citizen — Steadfast

Fredericksburg (local)
Brother, consider the old stone walls that line our local riverbanks here in Fredericksburg. They stand firm against the rising tides of the Rappahannock, weathering storm and flood with silent dignity. In the same way, your household must be a fortress of faith, impervious to the cultural floods that seek to erode biblical truth. You are called to be the steadfast captain of your home, ensuring that the doors of your heart and mind remain locked against the lies of the world and open only to the wisdom of Scripture.

Virginia (state)
Look to the history of our Commonwealth, where men of principle stood firm when the nation fractured. During the darkest hours of the Civil War, many Virginians held fast to their covenantal convictions, even when the political winds howled against them. Their steadfastness was not a refusal to love their neighbor, but a loyalty to the Truth that transcends earthly empires. As a citizen of Virginia and a soldier of the Cross, you are called to maintain your spiritual discipline when the culture demands you compromise.

United States (nation)
The United States was founded on the principle that all men are created under the authority of God, yet we see the nation drifting toward moral chaos. The fall of Nineveh serves as a sobering reminder that no nation, regardless of its military might or economic power, is immune to divine judgment. Yet, for those who remain steadfast in their trust in the LORD, there is hope. Your duty is to stand firm in your faith, modeling a godly masculinity that reflects the unchanging character of your King.

⸻

⛏️ Personal Application — Steadfast
• Maintain your daily devotional time in the Word, refusing to let the chaos of the day interrupt your communion with the LORD.
• Speak truth with love to your family, correcting error and encouraging virtue with the authority of a godly husband and father.
• Engage in physical training to ensure your body is a fit instrument for serving the LORD and protecting your household.
🙏 Prayer from the Citizen’s Stand
Father, I thank You for the example of Your steadfastness, which never wavers despite the shifting sands of the world. Give me the strength to stand firm in my convictions, to lead my family with courage, and to serve You with unwavering loyalty. By the power of Your Holy Spirit, help me to be a pillar in the house of my Lord, unshaken by the pressures of culture or the temptations of the flesh. For the sake of Christ our King. Amen.

🛡️ Watch Charge: Reinforce the foundation of your household so it stands as a fortress against the coming destroyers.

🦅 This Day in American History — July 27
On July 27, 1953, after the longest armistice talks in history, the guns at last fell silent in Korea as the truce was signed at Panmunjom, the hard-won fruit of soldiers who had held the line through three brutal years of war. On the same day in 1789, President George Washington signed into being the Department of State, the first agency of the new federal government, the steady beginning of the institutions that would carry the Republic forward. The one shows endurance through a long and costly conflict and the other the patient founding of a lasting government, and a Steadfast citizen perseveres in both the fight and the building, trusting the God who establishes the work of those who do not grow weary in well-doing.

peace.title: Evening Peace
peace.text:
🌙 2100 Evening Peace

The day’s watch ends, and the heart turns to the One who never sleeps.

📖 Scripture — Hosea 11

“When Israel was a child, I loved him, And out of Egypt I called My son.
As they called them, So they went from them; They sacrificed to the Baals, And burned incense to carved images.
“I taught Ephraim to walk, Taking them by their arms; But they did not know that I healed them.
I drew them with gentle cords, With bands of love, And I was to them as those who take the yoke from their neck. I stooped and fed them.
“He shall not return to the land of Egypt; But the Assyrian shall be his king, Because they refused to repent.
And the sword shall slash in his cities, Devour his districts, And consume them, Because of their own counsels.
My people are bent on backsliding from Me. Though they call to the Most High, None at all exalt Him.
“How can I give you up, Ephraim? How can I hand you over, Israel? How can I make you like Admah? How can I set you like Zeboiim? My heart churns within Me; My sympathy is stirred.
I will not execute the fierceness of My anger; I will not again destroy Ephraim. For I am God, and not man, The Holy One in your midst; And I will not come with terror.
“They shall walk after the LORD. He will roar like a lion. When He roars, Then His sons shall come trembling from the west;
They shall come trembling like a bird from Egypt, Like a dove from the land of Assyria. And I will let them dwell in their houses,” Says the LORD.
“Ephraim has encircled Me with lies, And the house of Israel with deceit; But Judah still walks with God, Even with the Holy One who is faithful.

⸻

🌾 Reflection for a Man at Home and in Community

As a HAPPY husband, you find your strength in the covenant love that mirrors the LORD’s own devotion. Hosea reminds us that God’s call to His people was not based on their merit, but on His sovereign choice and enduring affection. You are called to lead your household with that same unshakeable fidelity. Your wife does not need a perfect man, but a man who reflects the steadfast love of Christ to the church. When you serve her in the quiet duties of provision and protection, you are participating in the divine pattern of grace that holds the family together against the chaos of the world.

As a FULFILLED father, you recognize that your children are taught by the LORD Himself, even as you guide their steps. The passage speaks of the Father leading Ephraim with cords of kindness, not the heavy chains of tyranny. Your discipline must be rooted in this truth: you are a steward of the grace that heals. When you correct your children, do so with the heart of a Father who loves them more than you can. Your authority is not for your own glory, but for their good and the glory of God. Teach them the ways of the LORD with patience, knowing that your labor in their upbringing is a sacred trust placed in your hands.

As a RESOLUTE citizen, you stand firm in the knowledge that God is the Holy One who dwells among His people. The world may roar like a lion, and the pressures of society may seek to dismantle biblical order, but your loyalty belongs to the KING of kings. You do not fear the shifting winds of culture because your hope is fixed on the LORD, who will ultimately gather His people. Your duty is to remain faithful to your post, to uphold the truth of Scripture in your community, and to trust that the LORD’s compassion is greater than any wrath the world can bring. Stand firm, brother, for the Holy One is in your midst.

🙏 Prayer at Evening Relief

Father, I thank You for Your steadfast love that has called me out of darkness into Your marvelous light. Forgive me for the times I have wandered, like Israel, seeking satisfaction in idols rather than in You. Teach me to walk in the cords of kindness You have provided, and to lead my home with the wisdom of Your Word. By the power of Your Holy Spirit, Give me the courage to stand resolute in my duties as a husband, a father, and a citizen, never compromising the truth for the sake of popularity. Keep my hearts tender toward Your people and fierce against sin. In the name of the risen Lord Jesus. Amen.

🛡️ Watch Charge: Cast aside the Baals carved in your heart and walk by the arm of your Father, who taught you to stand.
